prompt: What is the only country in the world to invoke Napoleon in its national anthem?
answer: Poland. Its national anthem, **“Mazurek Dąbrowskiego”** (“Dąbrowski’s Mazurka”), refers to Napoleon Bonaparte in the line about what Bonaparte showed the Polish forces: **“Bonaparte has given us an example of how to conquer.”**
